name: yantraflow
description: Free n8n-style automation platform: Auto Video Maker (Shorts/Reels), Daily Funny Video (Pexels/Pixabay free-licence) to YouTube + Instagram + Telegram, admin panel, link preview to Telegram, SEED-based AI auto-posting, schedules (every N / daily at HH:MM), 24 ready-made projects and a drag-and-drop editor. Runs in the browser or 24x7 on your PC / Android (Termux).
author: Nirbhay Sharma (NISHU) — https://github.com/shanir01
